articles.title: European wildfires expose, detonate buried bombs and mines from past wars - CBS News
articles.description: The wildfires burning across Europe this summer have revealed World War I and II ordnance lurking beneath the blackened landscape.
articles.content: The wildfires burning across Europe this summer have exposed a potentially deadly threat lurking beneath the blackened landscape: rusty bombs and mines from World War I and II that threaten crews res… [+5620 chars]
